genericMedicine.name: Acetaminophen, Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide and Doxylamine Succinate

content.content: TYLENOL® COLD + FLU MULTI-SYMPTOM LIQUID GELS DAY

text.paragraph: ■ temporarily relieves these common cold/flu symptoms:
This product contains acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if you take

■ more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours
■ with other drugs containing acetaminophen
■ 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product
Allergy alert: Acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions. Symptoms may include:
If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away.
If sore throat is severe, persists for more than 2 days, is accompanied or followed by fever, headache, rash, nausea, or vomiting, consult a doctor promptly.

■ with any other drug containing acetaminophen (prescription or nonprescription). If you are not sure whether a drug contains acetaminophen, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
■ if you are now taking a prescription monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) (certain drugs for depression, psychiatric or emotional conditions, or Parkinson’s disease), or for 2 weeks after stopping the MAOI drug. If you do not know if your prescription drug contains an MAOI, ask a doctor or pharmacist before taking this product.
■ if you have ever had an allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients

section.title: Ask a doctor before use if you have

text.paragraph:
■ liver disease
■ persistent or chronic cough such as occurs with smoking, asthma or emphysema
■ cough that occurs with too much phlegm (mucus)

Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking the blood thinning drug
warfarin

paragraph.content: When using this product do not exceed recommended dose

section.title: Stop use and ask a doctor if

text.paragraph: ■ pain or cough gets worse or lasts more than 7 days
■ fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days

■ cough comes back or occurs with rash or headache that lasts
These could be signs of a serious condition.

code.displayName: OTC - PREGNANCY OR BREAST FEEDING SECTION

text.paragraph: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

paragraph.content: Keep out of reach of children.

text.paragraph: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. (1-800-222-1222) Quick medical attention is critical for adults as well as for children even if you do not notice any signs or symptoms.

item.content: do not take more than directed (see overdose warning)

tr.td:
adults and children 12 years
and over

■ take 2 capsules every 4 hours while symptoms last
■ do not take more than 8 capsules in 24 hours

text.paragraph:
■ store between 20-25°C (68-77°F)
■ avoid high humidity and excessive heat above 40°C (104°F)
■ protect from light
■ do not use if blister unit is torn or broken
